admission_rule: Every required identity field must equal the current frozen consumer contract and certification_status must equal CERTIFIED_PASS.
cold_replay_initial_policy: Until certified-carrier/full-reconstruction equivalence is separately certified, cold replay defaults to FULL_RECONSTRUCTION.
equivalence_requirement: Normalized exact carrier payload, construction digest, public-state digest, and all downstream stable scientific observations must be byte-identical between certified replay and full reconstruction.
purpose: Allow registered experiments to consume an already-certified exact carrier artifact instead of reconstructing the full lower-stage population when, and only when, all frozen identity gates match.
